profile.visual_desc: A human swordsman wearing dark grey armor with prominent rounded shoulder pads with blue tips. He has a dark blue tunic and pants with a long blue loincloth/sash bordered in gold hanging from his waist. A brown scabbard rests on his left hip. His most striking feature is long, flowing silver-white hair. He wields a large two-handed broadsword.
profile.face_cutin_desc: A close-up of a stern-faced man looking left. He wears a grey hooded cloak draped over his head. Under the hood, brown hair and a dark red headband are visible. He has sharp, intense eyes with dark blue irises and prominent dark eyebrows. His jawline is strong, set in a serious, determined expression.
profile.weapon_desc: Large two-handed broadsword held with both hands.
profile.step1_ready: Seen from behind (rear-isometric), facing top-left. He stands with his right leg forward, left leg back. Both hands grip the sword hilt near his right shoulder, blade pointing straight up.
profile.step2_windup: He raises the sword higher, leaning slightly right. His long white hair flows dramatically to the right as he prepares for a heavy downward swing.
profile.step3_impact: He swings the sword down and to the left. A massive, sweeping crescent of pale yellow energy bursts outward, following the wide arc of the blade from the top right down to the bottom left.
profile.step4_finish: The yellow energy trail quickly dissipates. He remains in a low, wide stance, facing left, with the sword held low and extended to the left, his hair settling.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: In Frame 4, a large, sweeping pale yellow energy crescent must trace the path of the sword from top-right down to bottom-left.

evaluation.diagnosis: Motion and VFX arcs align with reference. Minor hilt and limb scaling variances noted.
